content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] autoscaler: GPU pool eu-west-1/main hit scale_limit (60/60). Attempts to scale blocked. Queue length rising. Alert id: ag-1758884321
Marta (sre-oncall): I'm on it. Triage 1. Can someone confirm customer impact?
Alice (prod): We have operator reports: ~15% 5xx rate for hosted API routes, spike started ~1758884300. Several large tenants experiencing throttling.
Ben (eng-ml): seeing queue_depth=4.2k, head_latency > 2s. Autoscaler logs show provider 429 on scale up: "quota_exceeded".
Carla (infra): confirmed provider quota limit for eu-west GPUs. Cloud console shows max_gpus=60, used=60.
Marta (sre-oncall): mitigation plan: 1) enable model fallback to smaller quantized variant for non-critical tenants; 2) offload low-priority batch jobs; 3) open cloud quota increase ticket. Who can run the fallback?
Dinesh (runtime): I can flip fallback config. Running:
```
/ops/runbook/fallback-flip --pool eu-west-1/main --model-rules fallback_small
```
Dinesh: done. starting prefix cache switch. Will follow logs.
Carla: evicting background batch jobs on pool (low priority). Command:
```
kubectl -n inference patch job -l tier=background -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'
```
Carla: evictions started, ~120 pods scaled down.
Ben: autoscaler still failing to create nodes due to provider 429. Raised provider support case 12345.
Alice: customer facing: posted status page update: "Partial degradation in eu-west inference. We are mitigating. No data loss. Support handling impacted customers." :white_check_mark: 
Evan (SRE): routing rule applied to shift new traffic to us-east for critical tenants. Updated routing key for tenant t-42.
Marta (sre-oncall): monitoring: latency dropping slightly, 5xx rate from 15% -> 7% after fallbacks.
incident-bot: Pager silence by Marta acknowledged at 1758884420
Ben: quota ticket accepted by provider, ETA ~35m for soft quota bump.
Dinesh: fallback reduced token generation by ~25% for many requests. CPU on pool increased but we have headroom.
Alice: compiling customer impact: ~2.1k affected requests/min at peak, ~12 customers with >10% error rate for an ~18m window. No billing anomalies reported yet.
Marta (sre-oncall): handoff to night pager Evan in 30m. Evan, note provider ETA and follow eviction rollback once quota increased.
Evan: ack. I'll monitor and coordinate rollback. I'll also schedule rollback playbook:
```
/ops/runbook/rollback-evictions --pool eu-west-1/main
```
Carla: tickets created: CLOUD-789 (quota request), INFRA-452 (eviction log), POSTMORTEM-134.
Marta (sre-oncall): action items for postmortem:
- Investigate autoscaler retry/backoff behavior on provider 429 (owner: Ben)
- Adjust routing policy to proactively divert critical tenants before pool saturates (owner: Alice)
- Add quota headroom alert when pool usage > 80% (owner: Carla)
- Document fallout procedures for fallback model flips and eviction rollback (owner: Dinesh)
Evan: I'll run through the rollback once CLOUD-789 shows increased quota, and will verify per-tenant sane rollout.
Alice: final customer note drafted, posting to status in 5m after confirm stabilization.
Marta (sre-oncall): incident declared mitigated at 1758885120. Queue length back to ~400, 5xx <1%.
incident-bot: Incident closed as "scale_limit_eu-west-1758884321". Postmortem assigned: POSTMORTEM-134.
Marta: thanks all. please add any follow-ups to POSTMORTEM-134. :heart:
